svg.title: Labracadabra architecture
svg.desc: Browser, CloudFront, Cognito, IAM, S3, SQS, Lambda and the Anthropic API, with the request flow animated in seven steps.
svg.text: YOUR AWS ACCOUNT · ONE CDK STACK · NO SERVERS

g.text: The browser loads the static app from CloudFront (private S3 origin, strict security headers).
You sign in on Cognito's hosted page: invitation only, PKCE, optional or required MFA.
Your circle memberships map to IAM roles; the browser receives 1-hour AWS credentials.
The app talks straight to S3 (no API servers) and uploads a report to your inbox/ folder.
S3 → SQS → Lambda: the pages are sent to Claude, which only transcribes what is printed.
Deterministic code converts units, merges duplicates, flags trends, writes results.json.
The app shows the new values; every one links back to the highlighted source page.
